items.exampleEn: Online bidding for the concert tickets went on all night.
items.exampleZh: 演唱會門票的網路競標持續了一整晚。

items.exampleEn: I can't read the doctor's scribble on this note.
items.exampleZh: 我看不懂醫生在這張紙條上的潦草字跡。

items.exampleEn: Good teachers want understanding, not just obedience, from their students.
items.exampleZh: 好老師希望學生理解，而不只是服從。

items.exampleEn: Mom tacked the school calendar to the wall.
items.exampleZh: 媽媽把學校行事曆用圖釘釘在牆上。

items.exampleEn: He blurted out the answer before the teacher finished the question.
items.exampleZh: 老師還沒問完，他就脫口說出答案。

items.exampleEn: Reporters often intrude into the lives of famous people.
items.exampleZh: 記者常常侵擾名人的生活。

items.exampleEn: After his injury healed, he rejoined the team.
items.exampleZh: 傷好了以後，他重新歸隊。

items.exampleEn: The gleam of the new car caught everyone's eye.
items.exampleZh: 新車的光澤吸引了每個人的目光。

items.sentenceEn: Please don't blurt out the ending of the movie!
items.sentenceZh: 拜託別把電影結局說出來！

items.audioEn: Our dog finished obedience school, and now he sits as soon as we say so.
items.audioZh: 我們的狗上完服從訓練了，現在我們一說，牠就馬上坐下。
options: It goes to school every day
It sits when it is told

items.sentenceEn: I didn't want to intrude, so I waited outside the door.
items.sentenceZh: 我不想打擾，所以在門外等。

items.sentenceEn: After lunch, the tour group rejoined us at the museum.
items.sentenceZh: 午餐後，旅行團在博物館和我們會合。

items.stemEn: Could you ____ this poster to the board with a pin?
items.stemZh: 你可以用圖釘把這張海報釘在板子上嗎？

items.stemEn: In the old days, children were expected to show complete ____ to their parents.
items.stemZh: 從前，孩子被期望要完全服從父母。

items.passageEn: Last Friday, our school held a charity sale for the library, and people could bid for every item. Before it began, volunteers tacked a list of the items to the wall. A small handicraft went first, and then came a simple scribble by a famous artist. The bidding for it was fast. When the price reached five hundred dollars, a girl in the front row blurted out "Great!" and everyone laughed. In the end, a quiet old man won it and smiled happily.
items.passageZh: 上星期五，我們學校替圖書館辦了一場義賣會，每件物品都可以競標。開始前，志工把義賣品清單用圖釘釘在牆上。第一件是一個小手工藝品，接著是一位名畫家隨手畫的塗鴉。這件作品的出價非常快。價格到五百美元時，前排一個女孩脫口喊出「太棒了！」，大家都笑了。最後，一位安靜的老先生買下了它，開心地笑了。

questions.questionZh: 義賣會開始前，志工做了什麼？
options: 把義賣品清單釘在牆上

questions.questionZh: 最後是誰買下那張塗鴉？

items.promptZh: 黑暗中，我們看到遠方有一道微光。
referenceEn: In the dark, we saw a gleam of light far away.
We saw a faint gleam in the distance in the dark.
rubricZh: 要用 gleam（例如 a gleam of light、a faint gleam）
「遠方」可寫，例如 far away、in the distance 等
「黑暗中」可寫，例如 in the dark 等

items.promptZh: 我姊姊下個月會重新加入她以前的合唱團。
referenceEn: My sister will rejoin her old choir next month.
Next month, my older sister is going to rejoin her old choir.
rubricZh: rejoin 當動詞，後接團體（例如 rejoin her old choir 等）
「會」表示未來，可用表示未來的寫法（例如 will、be going to 等）
「姊姊」可寫，例如 sister、older sister 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：英文不自然（呼應自評疑慮 2）：blurt 名詞幾乎不用，"His blurt of 'No way!'" 不道地；同課 q09、閱讀也一樣。建議改教動詞 blurt (out)："He blurted out 'No way!'"。

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案："I heard a blurt of laughter" 不道地，母語者會說 a burst of laughter；聽打題會讓學習者記下錯誤搭配。
